native_mechanisms: One fold per mark, each fold's angle set jointly by the mark and the crease left by the previous fold (state carried forward into the angle).

Press every crease against all four wire-bird beaks at once and refold tighter until the four readings agree, with the sheet's spiral/snail markings deliberately mis-aligned so two different piles cannot look the same.

Thin the whole folded wad at the water's edge — together with the one small suitcase (the length) — down to one small dense coin, discarding every sheet, scrap and failed gauge reading so nothing survives to be compared next time.
core_technique: Multi-lane (4- or 8-way) streaming absorption where each 8-byte word is mixed by add-then-data-dependent-variable-rotate (rotate amount = low 6 bits of state XOR word), followed by two fixed-rotate cross-lane XOR diffusion rounds and a Murmur3-style multiply-shift finalizer.
